explanation.en: The statement asks «Should the retirement age be raised?». Argument I answers «No, old people get tired» and argument II answers «No, my grandfather wants to rest». A strong argument has to be a general, factual reason that bears on the decision itself, so weigh those two answers against each other: the pair comes out as «Neither argument is strong», which is option B.
explanation.as: তলৰ প্ৰশ্নটো «Should the retirement age be raised?»। যুক্তি I «No, old people get tired» আৰু যুক্তি II «No, my grandfather wants to rest» কয়। সবল যুক্তি সাধাৰণ আৰু তথ্যভিত্তিক হ'ব লাগে, সিদ্ধান্তৰ সৈতে পোনপটীয়াকৈ জড়িত হ'ব লাগে — এই মাপকাঠিত «Neither argument is strong» হয়, অৰ্থাৎ বিকল্প B।
